title: Add modem ergonomics, validation, examples, and benchmarking
description:
Polish the public modem API and demonstrate that it is both usable and performant. This story covers user-facing builders, examples, validation coverage, and benchmark coverage for the generic and optimized modem paths.

## Background

The framework is only successful if standard use cases are easy to discover and custom constellations remain approachable. The modem surface also needs benchmark coverage so future optimization work has a stable baseline and regressions are easy to detect.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Public documentation exposes named constructors for the standard presets and a documented custom-constellation builder workflow.
- [ ] Compiling examples cover at least one custom constellation, one Gray-QAM preset, and one simulation-harness integration path built from the shared modem surface.
- [ ] Benchmark coverage includes generic versus Gray-QAM fast-path comparisons and an analysis-disabled baseline for the normal hot path.
- [ ] Documentation explains the single-source-of-truth modem architecture, the supported demapper semantics, and when users should choose presets versus custom builders.

## Notes

This story should make the framework pleasant to use for both standard communications work and research experimentation.
